Cosmos Guardrail is a content safety model comprising of three components that enforce content safety. The components are as follows. 1. Blocklist: A set of human-curated keywords that are used to filter our corner-cases. 2. Video Content Safety Filter: A multi-class classifier model that is trained to distinguish between safe and unsafe frames of the generated video using SigLIP embeddings [google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384](https://huggingface.co/google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384). 3. * NVIDIA Hopper
